portfolioSite.title: egmn.dev
portfolioSite.description: My personal portfolio website built with Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and Tailwind CSS. Features responsive design, dark mode, internationalization, and a Raindrop.io integration to showcase my bookmarks collection.

flickMark.title: FlickMark
flickMark.description: An AI-powered iOS app for instant movie identification from screenshots and social media shares. Create smart watchlists and discover streaming availability worldwide. Features advanced scene recognition technology for quick film identification.

findepMoney.title: findep.money
findepMoney.description: Findep Money is a comprehensive tool designed to help users track their financial portfolio, aiming for financial independence and early retirement. It is a progressive web app (PWA), adhering to local-first principles. It ensures seamless functionality and data availability across both mobile and desktop platforms, providing a fast, reliable, and user-friendly experience while prioritizing data privacy and offline accessibility. Used technologies: Vue.js, Nuxt, PrimeVue, PowerSync, Tailwind CSS, and more.

teletextPage.title: teletext.page
teletextPage.description: Teletext Page is a project that aims to create a modern and functional teletext style page for individuals. Used technologies: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and more.

chargingStations.title: Charging Stations Mobile App
chargingStations.description: Charging Stations is a mobile app that allows users to find charging stations for their electric vehicles. Used technologies: React Native, Expo, Nativewind CSS, and more.
